scope: User request: every calendar name should show at least an unverified part. Names whose displayed text had no origin part at all (only a calendar date, a register record or a namesake) got a labelled supplement (reviewed text) or hypothesis (no text).
measurement: var/namedays-research/empty164.mjs plus a stricter filter (empty164b.json): 142 names (LV 15, LT 26, EE 101); Kalli already had a word link. After this round only three malformed Estonian calendar entries remain without text.
sources: Rajandi 1966 body text (EE-RAJANDI66, pages before the index) for name groups (nature names, sister and brother names), variants and base names; Estonian Wikipedia name articles were checked (Halliki) and give only bearer counts and namesakes, so they were not used for origins.
left_open: Antonia Ande, Kullar Kullo, Snno: malformed entries in the source file namedays.txt (two names joined or a misspelling); fix at the source.
